messages.content: Is it manipulative to withhold affection when I'm upset?
Honestly, kind of, yes - even if it's not intentional. It ends up teaching the other person to walk on eggshells instead of actually resolving what's wrong.
so what should i do instead when im upset
Fair question - actually just naming it directly works better: 'I'm upset right now and need a minute' is honest without punishing them silently for something they may not even understand yet.
